performance.summary: Performance lens on the fixture-guard fix. skipif guards evaluate one Path.exists() per module import — negligible; guarded tests now SKIP in client repos, cutting their vendored suite time; the portable event fixture scans one directory listing instead of assuming emptiness. No production code paths touched.

security.summary: Security lens on the fixture-guard fix. Test-only change: 15 tests gain skipif guards keyed on precise harness-source fixture paths or portable fixtures; no production code, no gate weakened — every guard still executes the full assertion in the harness-source repo, and the fixture-free client-scaffold proof asserts the guards skip (never fail) where fixtures are absent. No new subprocess, network, or file-write surface; the portable event-ledger fixture only reads the repo's own event directory.
residual_risks: A future harness-source-only test added without a guard would regress client CI again; the client-scaffold proof test only covers guarded names — flagged for the findings ledger
